messages:
Priya Rao: quick sync — Concordia asked to run a 90-min hands-on sprint adjacent to the main summit (Room B). can we confirm speaker pairing and kits?
Ethan Cole: ✅ I can take lead on infra demo. will run the realtime embeddings + vector search lab. need 10 laptop kits and 20 USB drives.
Kaitlyn M.: I’ll own speaker comms + slides. @Ethan do you want a co-presenter from Concordia?
Ethan Cole: yes, Concordia will send a TL;DR engineer — name TBA. @Kaitlyn can you prep a 5-slide joint intro?
Priya Rao: run-of-show draft: 5m intro, 10m partner talk, 50m hands-on labs, 15m q&a, 10m wrap. margins for 90.
Jordan Li: logistics check — A/V slot confirmed. I submitted request for 2 mics, HDMI, and a local WiFi SSID for the lab guests.
Maya Patel: swag ask — Concordia wants co-branded stickers + a small tote. do we want Redwood stickers + a sticker sheet for the kits?
Kaitlyn M.: stickers + one-pager in kits. recommend 2 stickers, 1 quickstart, 1 tiny cheat-sheet, and 1 coupon code card.
Ethan Cole: kit contents I need: USB (pref preloaded with lab), docker-compose.yml, sample dataset, quickstart.md. can we get the USBs imaged?
Logistics Bot: Shipment created: 3 boxes (10 kits each) -> Carrier: ShipFast, Est delivery: 2026-04-28, Tracking: https://shipfast.example/track/ZX12345
Priya Rao: thanks @Logistics Bot. Jordan — can you confirm on-site pickup window?
Jordan Li: pickup scheduled for 04/28 9:00-11:00 from loading dock C. I'll be on-site as point of contact.
Maya Patel: swag vendor ETA: stickers in by 04/22, totes by 04/24. if any delays we pivot to plain totes + sticker sheets.
Kaitlyn M.: speaker rehearsal — proposed times: 04/27 10:00 PT (virtual) and 04/28 13:00 PT (on-site quick run). @Ethan are both ok?
Ethan Cole: yep both good. I'll include a 2-min fallback demo in case cloud quota is down (local container). snippet for instructors: ```docker run -p 8080:8080 redwood/demo-lab:latest```
Priya Rao: contingency plan: if hosted capacity hits limit, fallback to quantized local model (instructions in quickstart.md). add a note to runbook to flip the model flag.
Kaitlyn M.: assigning tasks: Ethan (lab content + fallback), Jordan (A/V + kit pickup), Maya (swag + shipping oversight), Priya (partner coordination + runbook final). I'll send calendar invites after Concordia confirms speaker.
Ethan Cole: estimating lab runtime per attendee ~25-30m. need 1 instructor per 8 attendees. recommend 3 instructors for up to 24 people.
Priya Rao: headcount ask sent to Concordia — waiting on final RSVP (they expect ~18). if >24 we open ticketing to overflow session.
Logistics Bot: Reminder scheduled: 04/25 09:00 PT -> 'Confirm kits imaged and final packing list'
Maya Patel: one more — customs docs for cross-border swag: need HS codes + invoice. I'll share with finance in #finance.
Kaitlyn M.: noted. last call for content changes: 04/24 EOD. after that we lock slides and lab image.
Priya Rao: perfect. thanks team — will update thread when Concordia confirms speaker and RSVP. :thumbsup:
